scenes.title: Gessiera Viaduct at km 81.500
scenes.description: A photograph by Achille Mauri, dated 1883, showing the Gessiera at kilometre 81.500 on the Termoli-Campobasso railway line.
scenes.explanation: Tower cranes with steel lattice jibs were not developed until the mid-20th century, making them impossible in an 1883 construction scene.

scenes.title: Interior, Stained Glass
scenes.description: A photograph of an interior with stained glass, taken in 1990 in Losser. The record credits the photograph to Europeana and licenses it under CC BY-SA.
scenes.explanation: Flexible white LED strip lighting did not exist in 1990, so a lit tape strip on this window frame is impossible for the photograph's year.

scenes.title: Over arm stroke [swimming]
scenes.description: This press photograph, taken by Agence Rol in 1911, shows swimmers. It is held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France, département Estampes et photographie, and is in the public domain.
scenes.anomaly: modern swim cap with silicone dome shape
scenes.explanation: Stretch silicone swim caps did not exist in 1911; swimmers then used bare heads or cloth and rubber caps of a different shape.

scenes.title: Lillestrøm Square
scenes.description: A photograph from the National Library of Norway shows Lillestrøm torg in 1963. It is in the public domain.
scenes.explanation: Compact folding camping chairs with tubular frames and fabric seats did not exist in 1963.
scenes.credit: Mittet & Co. AS via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: Aleksis Kiven katu 1, 3
scenes.description: A photograph showing the brick wall and windows of the Harju youth centre, with graffiti on the foundation and eaves and stickers also glued to the eavestroughs. It was taken in Finland on Aleksis Kiven katu 1, 3 on 2017-08-29 and licensed CC BY 4.0.
scenes.explanation: A humanoid robot that climbs brickwork and inspects a drainpipe on its own is a fictional future machine and cannot exist in 2017.

source.description: sisällön kuvaus: Aleksis Kiven katu 1, 3. Harjun nuorisotalon tiiliseinää sekä ikkunoita. Kivijalassa ja räystäässä graffiteja. Räystäsputkiin liimattu myös tarroja.
